BEHAVIOR SCORE PROBLEM
10 Oct @ 6:52pm
3,14159
For the past few months, my Behavior Score has only been going down. I receive an average of 30 commends every 15 matches, and there are conduct summaries where I do not receive a single report, yet my Behavior Score still decreases.

This game’s Behavior Score system is terrible. Many players come into someone else’s lane, grief the match, and then report other players. Those reports are still counted and end up lowering the Behavior Score of innocent players.
